info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Status API provides real-time insights into the status of mortgage loans. This endpoint allows users to query the current state of loans, enabling organizations to monitor applications and assess processing timelines effectively. Typical consumers include financial institutions and loan servicing companies that require up-to-date information for customer support and internal reporting. Utilizing this API helps enhance transparency and improves the decision-making process regarding loan management.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of loans.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the status of their loans, providing insights into the current state and any relevant updates. It is essential for users to stay informed about their financial obligations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the status of loans. It includes the necessary data structure required by the API to process the request successfully.

200.description: Request completed successfully, loan status retrieved.

ListMortgageLoansStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to loan status. It is expected to be a string representing the specific loan status requested.

ListMortgageLoansStatusResponse_200.title: Loan Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the loan operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the loan operation.

state.description: The current state of the loan process.

processingTimeMs.description: The total time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the operation status.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the loan operation.

ListMortgageLoansStatusResponse_200.description: The response object containing the status of a loan operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the loan record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the loan record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the loan operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Contains auditing information related to the loan operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value indicates how long the server took to generate the response.
